joi_block.name: Scenario
joi_block.script:
wait until((#Entrance_Lock).doorLock_doorLockState == "closed", timeout: 10 MIN)
(#Entrance_Lock).doorLock_lock()
(#Living_Speaker).speaker_speak("The door lock has been locked")

precision_reasoning: confirmed ir_gt + binding_gt; no NL mapping
command_kor: 밤 11시에 도어락이 잠기기를 10분까지 기다렸다가, 그래도 안 잠겨 있으면 잠그고 스피커로 알려줘.
command_eng: At 11 PM, wait up to 10 minutes for the door lock to be locked; if it is still unlocked, lock it and notify me through the speaker.

args.Text: The door lock has been locked
